svg.title: Nested retries multiply downstream attempts
svg.desc: Worst case before fan-out: one logical request encounters three nested retry layers, each allowing three TOTAL attempts including its initial call. Gateway attempts produce 3 API calls; API attempts produce 9 SDK calls; SDK attempts produce 27 dependency calls when all retry budgets exhaust. 3 x 3 x 3 = 27 downstream attempts, not 27 retries plus an initial call. Choose one retry owner per dependency and one end-to-end deadline.

text.tspan: 1 logical request | 3 total attempts per layer
Initial attempt + up to 2 retries at each layer
